description: AI project-management platform for portfolios, programs and projects, with AI agents, collaboration, analytics, approvals, enterprise governance and Microsoft integrations.

evidence.finding: ChatPM publishes role and enterprise workflow controls, including custom AI configuration and identity controls for higher-tier plans.
ChatPM documents import and export of project data and reports so customers can extract information from the platform for use elsewhere.
ChatPM's privacy policy explains what project and personal data it collects, where project data may be hosted, how it is processed, and when it is shared.
ChatPM documents approval and sign-off workflows in which users review, comment on, approve, or reject submissions rather than delegating final approval to automation.
ChatPM offers a 30-day free trial and publishes plan-specific project-management, analytics, support, and training features before purchase.
ChatPM's privacy policy gives users rights to access, correct, delete, restrict processing of, withdraw consent for, and request a portable copy of personal and project data.
ChatPM supports project-data export and offers an Enterprise on-premises deployment option in which project-related data can remain on the customer's infrastructure.
ChatPM publishes monthly and annual plan prices and states that subscriptions renew automatically unless the customer cancels before the renewal date.
ChatPM explicitly supports team collaboration through shared project data, meeting workflows, action tracking, approval workflows, and Microsoft Teams integration.
ChatPM's agentic-AI guidance says humans should retain oversight of important decisions and define what AI agents may access, recommend, approve, or execute.
ChatPM provides a 30-day free trial, video training, and tiered plans that start with independent professionals and small teams before scaling to enterprise use.

limitations: This preliminary audit uses public ChatPM primary-source documentation and has not yet been reviewed by ChatPM.
A published product claim is treated as evidence of the documented policy or feature, not proof of real-world outcomes.
Humanity Score is a product-impact rating, not a regulatory, legal, safety, compliance, or government certification.
correction_policy: Source-backed factual corrections are welcome. Corrections change the audit only when the underlying evidence changes; payment cannot buy a higher score.
